topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I thought the night sky was vast enough to keep us worlds apart, safe in our separate corners. Finding out you're just a few streets away feels like the forest has suddenly shrunk, the spaces between the trees closing in. It's strange how silence can echo so loudly when you're not expecting it. The air feels different now, heavier, like the weight of fallen leaves we haven't swept away yet. I don’t know what to make of it, this unintended closeness. The thought of you being so near stirs something, a quiet unease in the still of the night.
